topic: Sensor data issues and antenna placement
summary_markdown:
A discussion was held regarding significant data problems observed across 5 out of 10 sensors in Belgium. The primary issue identified is that half the sensors do not have recorded data with a signal strength greater than -80Db.

Participants agreed on two key follow-up actions: first, to schedule a meeting to discuss these sensor issues further; and second, to understand the physical placement of antennas using photos.
decisions: A meeting was scheduled for 12:30 (Danish time) to discuss the data problems.
action_items: [p1] to double-check information regarding the sensors' historical performance.
